name: 转经纬度
description: 十进制与度分秒互转（纬度 lat / 经度 lon）。纯 Math 实现，无需沙箱 API。dms-to-dec 输入约定 DDDMMSS.ss 紧凑格式（lat 度占 2 位、lon 度占 3 位）。

inputs.label: 输入（十进制或 DDDMMSS.ss 紧凑格式）

emit:
var input = helpers.getInputVar(ctx, node);
var mode = helpers.data(node).mode || 'dec-to-dms';
var axis = helpers.data(node).axis || 'lat';
var out = helpers.outVar(node);
var m = helpers.jsString(mode);
var a = helpers.jsString(axis);
return indent + 'var ' + out + ' = (function(v, mode, axis){\n' +
  indent + '  var pad = function(n, w){ n = String(n); while (n.length < (w || 2)) n = "0" + n; return n; };\n' +
  indent + '  var hemi = function(val, isLat){\n' +
  indent + '    if (isLat) return val >= 0 ? "N" : "S";\n' +
  indent + '    return val >= 0 ? "E" : "W";\n' +
  indent + '  };\n' +
  indent + '  if (mode === "dms-to-dec") {\n' +
  indent + '    var raw = String(v).replace(/[^0-9.\-NSEW]/gi, "").toUpperCase();\n' +
  indent + '    var neg = /S|W/.test(raw);\n' +
  indent + '    raw = raw.replace(/[NSEW\-]/g, "");\n' +
  indent + '    var dot = raw.indexOf(".");\n' +
  indent + '    var intPart = dot >= 0 ? raw.slice(0, dot) : raw;\n' +
  indent + '    var fracPart = dot >= 0 ? raw.slice(dot) : "";\n' +
  indent + '    var degW = axis === "lat" ? 2 : 3;\n' +
  indent + '    while (intPart.length < degW + 4) intPart = "0" + intPart;\n' +
  indent + '    var d = parseInt(intPart.substr(0, degW), 10) || 0;\n' +
  indent + '    var mi = parseInt(intPart.substr(degW, 2), 10) || 0;\n' +
  indent + '    var se = parseFloat(intPart.substr(degW + 2, 2) + fracPart) || 0;\n' +
  indent + '    var dec = d + mi / 60 + se / 3600;\n' +
  indent + '    return String((neg ? -dec : dec).toFixed(6));\n' +
  indent + '  }\n' +
  indent + '  var dec = typeof v === "number" ? v : parseFloat(String(v).replace(/[^0-9.\-]/g, ""));\n' +
  indent + '  if (isNaN(dec)) return "INVALID_GEO";\n' +
  indent + '  var abs = Math.abs(dec);\n' +
  indent + '  var d = Math.floor(abs);\n' +
  indent + '  var minFloat = (abs - d) * 60;\n' +
  indent + '  var mi = Math.floor(minFloat);\n' +
  indent + '  var se = (minFloat - mi) * 60;\n' +
  indent + '  var degW = axis === "lat" ? 2 : 3;\n' +
  indent + '  return pad(d, degW) + "\u00b0" + pad(mi) + "\u2032" + pad(se, 2).split(".")[0] + "\u2033" + hemi(dec, axis === "lat");\n' +
  indent + '})(' + input + ', ' + m + ', ' + a + ');\n';
